images.name: satin-light-desktop
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an art-directed premium Santi020k branded desktop wallpaper, widescreen 16:9 landscape, full bleed. Image 1 is the canonical logo: preserve the white rounded terminal >_ prompt proportions on a saturated solid #5a0fdb purple rounded square. Image 2 is an approved wallpaper reference for polish, restraint, brand tile scale, and photographic 3D material quality; create a distinctly different scene. One small physical brand tile only, about 12% of canvas width, nearly front-facing so the canonical white glyph is precise. Keep the left half and upper third quiet for desktop icons. No wordmark, slogans, UI, devices, borders or repeated logos. New direction: SATIN, light edition. A flowing landscape of luxurious pearl-lavender satin fabric, huge soft folds entering from bottom left and rolling toward the lower right, subtle fine woven texture and cool lilac shadows. Nest the single purple brand tile gently in a broad fabric fold near 65% across and 63% down, like a small softly rounded porcelain object resting on silk. Pale porcelain #f8f6fd background merging with the silk and generous airy negative space. Daylight from the upper left gives long delicate shadows and luminous fabric highlights. Elegant, tactile, believable materials, no glass bubbles, no arches. Rich purple tile anchors an otherwise subdued lavender-white composition. Output one landscape image.
